name: Eggplant-Basil Ratatouille with Chickpeas & Garlic Breadsticks
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Trim and medium dice eggplants and zucchini; place both in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Roughly chop tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the eggplant and zucchini.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion lengthwise into strips. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add veggies and spices to the skillet; reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook, stirring halfway through, until softened, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.

Drizzle oil over the flatbreads, then sprinkle with garlic and spices; cut into 1½-inch wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
When the veggies are ready, stir chickpeas and basil into the ratatouille (reserving a small handful of basil for garnish). Continue to cook, stirring often, until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Divide ratatouille between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
